column2: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS bucket, MAX(velocity) AS max_velocity FROM readings WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-01-04 00:00:00' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket;

SELECT t.name, DATE_TRUNC('hour', d.created_at) AS bucket, AVG(d.fuel_state) AS avg_fuel_state FROM diagnostics AS d JOIN tags AS t ON d.tags_id = t.id WHERE d.created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND d.created_at < '2026-01-04 00:00:00' GROUP BY t.id, t.name, bucket ORDER BY t.id, bucket;

SELECT t.name, r.created_at, r.velocity FROM readings AS r JOIN tags AS t ON r.tags_id = t.id WHERE r.velocity >= 50 AND r.created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND r.created_at < '2026-01-04 00:00:00' ORDER BY r.created_at, r.tags_id, r.velocity;

SELECT tags_id, created_at, velocity FROM (SELECT tags_id, created_at, velocity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tags_id ORDER BY created_at DESC, velocity DESC) AS rn FROM readings) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY tags_id;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('minute', created_at) AS bucket, MAX(fuel_state) AS max_fuel_state FROM diagnostics WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-01-04 00:00:00' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket DESC LIMIT 5;
